text: The Terms of Reference for the Toronto Music Advisory Committee (TMAC) state that at the call of the Chair, TMAC will meet quarterly or more frequently, if required. The following additional meetings of the Toronto Music Advisory Committee have been scheduled: Date: Wednesday, May 13, 2020 Time: 10:00 a.m. Location: Committee Room 1 Toronto City Hall, 2nd Floor 100 Queen Street West Date: Thursday, September 24, 2020 Time: 2:30 p.m. Location: Committee Room 2 Toronto City Hall, 2nd Floor 100 Queen Street West Date: Monday, November 16, 2020 Time: 2:30 p.m. Location: Committee Room 2 Toronto City Hall, 2nd Floor 100 Queen Street West
